description: Test suite for TUI (Text User Interface) functionalities, including command parsing, session management, disconnection handling, input deduplication, and safety mechanisms in a TypeScript project.

methods.name: resolveFinalAssistantText
methods.description: Determines the final display text for the assistant, prioritizing finalText, then streamedText, then errorMessage formatting.

methods.name: parseCommand
methods.description: Parses slash commands input into command name and arguments, normalizing aliases and case.

methods.name: getSlashCommands
methods.description: Returns available slash commands, including context and commands.

methods.name: resolveTuiSessionKey
methods.description: Generates a session key based on scope, raw input, current agent ID, and session main key.

methods.name: resolveInitialTuiAgentId
methods.description: Infers the initial agent ID based on configuration, current working directory, and input session.

methods.name: resolveGatewayDisconnectState
methods.description: Provides guidance and status information based on gateway disconnect reasons.

methods.name: createBackspaceDeduper
methods.description: Creates a function to deduplicate backspace key events within a specific window.

methods.name: resolveCtrlCAction
methods.description: Determines action (clear, warn, exit) based on Ctrl+C presses timing and input state.

methods.name: isIgnorableTuiStopError
methods.description: Checks if an error encountered during TUI shutdown is ignorable (e.g., EBADF).

methods.name: stopTuiSafely
methods.description: Executes a cleanup function safely, ignoring certain stop errors.

ctags.name: state
ctags.pattern: /^    const state = resolveGatewayDisconnectState("gateway closed (1008): pairing required");$/
